title: The 1932 New York records on Vocalion
summary: His six-piece band's 1932 Brunswick sessions at 1619 Broadway, his first New York trip, with tunes including King Kong Stomp.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I was wondering about the other records you made with your band on Vocalion in Brunswick. You said you made it for the Brunswick people.
Yeah, well they put them on Vocalion. That was made in New York. It was made in New York, 1619 Broadway.
Yeah, I'll never forget that because that was my first time going to New York.
What year was that? Do you remember the year too?
Yeah, 32. And I had, I made King Kong Stomp. That was my tune. After Me, The Sun Go Down. I have quite a few of those records here by the way.
I don't have hardly any of them. At one time I had three or four of them. I don't have maybe one or two now around. I wish I'd saved all of them. I've lost a couple of them.
